title: E not by construction for condensate prey: in a predator-prey world whose prey matter is never made from fuel, cutting the fuel dissolves every prey body within 500 t on 2 seeds (with and without predators) while the prey material stays in solution, and the predators then grow on the dissolved prey
summary: world.py (defaults: beta 6, kq 0.003, Mb 0.01, predators added as noise at t=2000; parent sighting 20261026T1802-c46-driven-prey-sighting) has prey bodies made of a conserved Cahn-Hilliard material that is miscible (r0 0.3) unless drawn up its own catalysis product p, which needs a consumed, regrowing fuel F; no reaction turns fuel into prey matter. Fork at t=6000 (F set to 0, regrowth kF 0), seeds 0 and 1, T=7000, drive.py counts (bodies = connected c>0.5, >= 4 px): prey 23 -> 0 (seed 0) and 25 -> 0 (seed 1) by t=6500, against 23 and 24 in the fed twins at t=7000; in the predator-free fork 19 -> 0 and 12 -> 0 by t=6500 with the mean prey material unchanged (0.252 -> 0.252, 0.246 -> 0.246). With predators the freed prey material feeds them: mean predator material 0.042 -> 0.100 and 0.021 -> 0.052 over the 1000 t after the cut, predator bodies 26 -> 27 and 14 -> 14, so the predators survive the fuel cut that kills their prey (fork/z_fork.png).

finding.operator: fuel-driven condensation (prey material drawn up its own fuel-made catalysis product, miscible without it)
finding.control: abrupt fuel removal at a fork with the fed twin alongside, seeds 0 and 1, with and without predators
finding.result: prey bodies 23/25 -> 0/0 within 500 t (fed twins 23/24 at t=7000); predator-free 19/12 -> 0/0 with prey material conserved (mean 0.252, 0.246 unchanged); predator material doubles after the cut

limits: Counts from drive.py, not labkit packs; 128^2 only; no dt/2 check. The predators' dependence on prey is by construction (made only from prey material); only the prey's E is dynamical. In this regime the ecology freezes after t~5000 into static prey bodies and predator droplets living on dissolved prey (see the lk packs in the next claim attempt), so it is not yet a claim of IXDE.
